cues: A four mark question, Group B, number one: distinguish collenchyma from sclerenchyma under four headings.
Wall: cellulose and pectin versus lignin.
Thickening: uneven versus uniform and heavy.
Role: flexible support in a growing organ versus rigid support in a mature one.
text: A four mark question, Group B, number one: distinguish collenchyma from sclerenchyma under four headings. Cells: living versus dead. Wall: cellulose and pectin versus lignin. Thickening: uneven versus uniform and heavy. Role: flexible support in a growing organ versus rigid support in a mature one.
